roles.summary: Employers want Python+SQL, statistics and experimentation (A/B tests, causal inference) and the ability to turn analysis into product decisions. Note: several LinkedIn results carry older job IDs and could not be confirmed as 2026; the Happyrobot posting is dated 2026.
